title: Fleet closeout/forget swallow git and daemon errors — branch delete reported ok unconditionally
wanted_capability: Error observability on two paths. (a) fleet_worktree.rs closeout Remove phase: `let _ = git_run(base_repo, &["branch","-D",branch])` with content["deleted_branch"] set regardless of result — PhaseResult reports ok even when the delete failed (observability nit, not a leak: closeout DOES reap branches). Capture the result, surface a warning on failure. (b) forget_standalone_agents swallows daemon DELETE errors (`let _ = app.orch.forget(&id)`) — inconsistent with remove_agent_row's fallible path.
notes: D3+D4 from thread-4719ad45, both re-verified present on POST-campaign HEAD 2026-06-11: D3 at fleet_worktree.rs ~1370 (`let _ = git_run(..branch -D..)` in both arms, deleted_branch reported unconditionally); D4 at fleet_tui.rs:3616 (`let _ = app.orch.forget(&id)` in forget_standalone_agents). Error-path observability shapes — live validation would require inducing git/daemon failures, judged disproportionate; closeout was verified to reap branches in the happy path during dogfood.
resolution_note: Fixed in f06c957: closeout Remove phase captures git branch -D result — failure surfaces branch_kept_delete_failed + branch_delete_warning instead of a false deleted_branch claim (phase stays ok; warning not a leak). forget_standalone_agents logs each failed daemon DELETE and flashes a status summary, consistent with remove_agent_row.
